name: Eternalisk scale
description: A shimmering scale from an eternalisk that Boeb wears around his neck, a gift from his father.

timeline.summary: Flib climbs onto Boeb's chest with an eternalisk scale and begins hacking at its string with his axe.
timeline.quote: Flib, as if reading her mind, produced his axe and began to hack at the rope.

timeline.summary: Boeb's sorrow is revealed: his father's death sent him into name sleep, and the scale was his father's gift.
timeline.quote: He had lost his father, and he was so overcome by grief that he had fallen into name sleep.

pages_say.description: A shimmering scale from an eternalisk that Boeb wears around his neck, a gift from his father.
